text: そのポケモンを　こうかんすると　せんとうできなくなっちゃうよ！

structure.jp: せんとうできなく　なっちゃうよ！
structure.en: it will become unable to battle!

patterns.name: 〜と
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that when this happens, the result follows. こうかんすると = 'if you trade'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is a casual, contracted form of てしまう, meaning it ends up that way, often unfortunately. なっちゃう = 'ends up becoming'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.span: できなく　なっちゃう
patterns.explanation: The い-ending of a negative changes to く and なる means 'become'. できなくなる = 'become unable'.
